## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / Capability (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Research / Fixture update (modifying deterministic evaluation data)

## Verification Checklist

Please ensure you have completed the following before requesting a review, in accordance with `CONTRIBUTING.md`:

- [ ] I have identified the failure mode or requirement.
- [ ] I have added or updated a versioned fixture with the expected result (if applicable).
- [ ] I have stated which experimental condition should change and which should not.
- [ ] I have implemented this change through public package boundaries (no legacy `src/` imports).
- [ ] I have run `bun run check` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have documented any limitations or incompatible changes.
